_comment: BW Project distributed voice processor for Pterodactyl. Import this egg, select a Python 3.12 yolk, and assign a TCP allocation.
name: BW Voice Processor
author: bwproject
description: Encrypted AES-256-GCM PCM voice mixer for Discord-Lolka Voice Bridge (no TLS certificates required).

variables.name: Bind IP
variables.description: Keep 0.0.0.0 so Pterodactyl allocation can reach the server.

variables.name: Port
variables.description: Must match the TCP allocation assigned to this Pterodactyl server.

variables.name: Shared secret
variables.description: Generate a random secret with: openssl rand -hex 32. Use exactly the same secret on the bot server.
